description.p: Moment keeps a short replay buffer so you can save recent gameplay with a shortcut. Browse local captures, take screenshots, and trim clips into MP4 files.
Screen capture uses the desktop's screen-sharing permission. Your clips remain in your local videos and pictures folders unless you choose to share one.

screenshot.caption: Browse and play saved clips in the local library

description.p: Initial Flatpak packaging for Moment's focused gameplay replay and local clip workflow.
